units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 17a:7">M. Kat. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>דאפי׳ … לא חַנִּיפִי ליה</he> not even a man like thee did I flatter.
<cite ref="Shevuot 30a:14">Shebu. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>לחַנּוּפֵי ליה</he> that I should favor him in court?—

Keth. 84ᵇ מְחַנְּפִיתוּ להו would you favor them?; ib. 63ᵇ מַחְנִיפִיתוּ ליה (Af.) would you favor him?—Pesik. Asser, p. 98ᵃ (ref. to Is. XXIV, 5) את סבר מְחַנְּפָא לה והיא מְחַנְּפָה לך thou meanest to deceive it (the land by withholding the tithes, v. preced.), but it will disappoint thee; Tanḥ. R’eeh 14 את כבר מחנף וכ׳ (corr. acc.).
